caption: Community Subgraph G c : The community subgraph forms the highest level of Zep's knowledge graph. Community nodes (communities), n i ∈ N c , represent clusters of strongly connected entities. Communities contain high-level summarizations of these clusters and represent a more comprehensive, interconnected view of G s 's structure. Community edges, e i ∈ E c ⊆ φ * (N c × N s ), connect communities to their entity members.
